title: Core Sound Effect
blurb: Every possible mood eventually got a name, a moodboard and a suffix, and this is the sting that announces which one you have. Cottagecore, weirdcore, corporate-core, goblincore — the -core construction swept the internet and turned aesthetic self-classification into a full genre of short video. The sound is the transition itself: a beat of setup, then the reveal. Play it before disclosing anybody's aesthetic, sincerely or otherwise, and remember that the format works best when the category is faintly insulting.
origin: The transition sting from the '-core' aesthetic meme genre.
